samples.question: The image is a coarse 32-by-32 cell grid whose pixel rows have each been cyclically scrolled by a fixed oblique ramp: row r is rolled by 7*r mod 32 cells leftwards, smearing a hidden binary symbol into a sheared diagonal splat that is not readable directly. Undo the declared cipher: cyclically roll every pixel row back by 7*r mod 32 cells to the right and reassemble the aligned 32x32 grid. That reconstruction is one of two declared abstract symbols: a hollow square ring (A) or a diagonal cross X (B). Which symbol appears, A or B? Answer A or B.
